rows.en:
{C:81900400}{C:81958296983200000000}It's the same here. The concentration is rising.
We can still get out now. What will you do?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296993200000000}We can carry on, can't we, big brother?

{C:81930100}{C:819582969A3200000000}Yeah.
We have to enter
some continent or other, anyway.

{C:81900400}{C:819582969B3200000000}And we need information on the Norstan.

{C:81900300}{C:819582969C3200000000}Exactly.

{C:819582969D3200000000}With any luck,
we might find more people
willing to join us.


{x00}

{C:81930400}{C:81958296D23200000000}Is that a blip on the radar?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296D33200000000}Should we prepare for battle?

{C:81930400}{C:81958296D43200000000}There's only one machine,
so I don't think we need to go that far.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296D53200000000}Then I'll ask
my brother to go out.



{x00}

{C:81930300}{C:81958296D63200000000}Big brother!
An unidentified flying object is approaching.
Go out in Impulse 7 and take a look.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D73200000000}Understood. I'll launch right away.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900400}{C:81958296D83200000000}Is that the machine that came from the Cloud Sea?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D93200000000}Yes, but...
It's obviously an FT, isn't it?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296DA3200000000}Is there anything in the cockpit?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DB3200000000}I'm looking right now, aren't I?
...Oh, here it is.
I'll put it on the monitor.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930700}{C:81958296DC3200000000}Good work on your mission to pursue the Norstan.
That's what Akatsuki
would probably say, but...

{C:81958296DD3200000000}Above all, I'm concerned
about your safety.

{C:81958296DE3200000000}So, to ease your burden even a little,
I've sent the newly developed 
{C:819782830400}ＦＴ－Ⅱ Cloud Saber{C:819782830000}.

{C:81958296E03200000000}I'm sure you can handle it.
Protect Rie and Nelfea for me.
I'm counting on you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E13200000000}I know, Professor.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296E23200000000}Make sure you protect us, big brother.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E33200000000}Still, the Professor takes some crazy risks.
What was the plan
if we hadn't picked it up?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296E43200000000}What are you talking about?!
Unc... the Professor would never
do something like that without being sure.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296E63200000000}Then how did the Professor
know where we were?


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900400}{C:81958296E73200000000}Well, that's... mumble, mumble.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296E83200000000}Ahahahaha!
Sorry, sorry.
I was only joking!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296E93200000000}Oh!
Rie, you're so mean!!
